title: 安全資訊事件管理
summary: 以日誌正規化、事件關聯與可用性串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。
summaryEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect log normalization, event correlation and availability through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.
scope: 公開原理的離線／本地合成資料工程教育。只使用自行生成資料或明確獲授權的測試環境；不提供真實目標掃描、漏洞利用、惡意程式、車輛／工控注入或實際射頻發射程序。數值為原創假設，非供應商保證或現場驗收標準。
scopeEn: Offline/local synthetic-data engineering education from public principles. Use authored data or explicitly authorized test environments only. No real-target scanning, exploitation, malware, vehicle/OT injection or live RF procedures. Numerical cases are original assumptions, not supplier guarantees or field acceptance criteria.

stages.title: 需求、元件與基本模型
stages.description: 四個領域技術單元各完成原理建模與對照證據，共八項可個別保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Four domain units each pair principle modeling with controlled evidence, producing eight separately saved tasks.

steps.title: 來源盤點：架構與原理
steps.titleEn: Source inventory: architecture and principle
steps.objective: 針對「來源盤點」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For source inventory, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「來源盤點」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：事件來源應有責任人、格式與健康指標。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定事件，只改時區及時間偏差。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「收集通道」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around source inventory, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Sources need owners, formats and health indicators. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix events and vary timezones/clock offsets. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat collection channels as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 固定事件，只改時區及時間偏差。 比較「來源盤點」與「收集通道」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix events and vary timezones/clock offsets. Compare whether evidence for source inventory and collection channels supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 把所有日誌集中便能自動判斷事故。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Centralizing every log automatically identifies incidents. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「來源盤點」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for source inventory. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 原理、架構與適用邊界
knowledge.text: 事件來源應有責任人、格式與健康指標。
knowledge.textEn: Sources need owners, formats and health indicators.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「收集通道」：傳輸完整性與來源認證影響證據可靠性。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「來源盤點」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring collection channels: Transport integrity/source authentication affect evidence reliability. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove source inventory passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 固定事件，只改時區及時間偏差。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Fix events and vary timezones/clock offsets. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假想每日 100 GB 原始事件，保留 30 日得 3 TB；兩複本得 6 TB，若索引另外 20% 得 7.2 TB；未計壓縮，容量假設須逐項標示。
knowledge.textEn: Assume 100 GB/day for 30 days: 3 TB raw; two replicas require 6 TB, plus 20% indexing gives 7.2 TB before compression, with all assumptions explicit.

quiz.question: 針對「來源盤點」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains the principle/observability of source inventory?
options: 事件來源應有責任人、格式與健康指標。
把所有日誌集中便能自動判斷事故。
只檢查「收集通道」，便可取代「來源盤點」的專屬驗證。
optionsEn: Sources need owners, formats and health indicators.
Centralizing every log automatically identifies incidents.
Checking collection channels alone replaces verification specific to source inventory.
quiz.explanation: 事件來源應有責任人、格式與健康指標。 相鄰的「收集通道」有不同責任：傳輸完整性與來源認證影響證據可靠性。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Sources need owners, formats and health indicators. Neighboring collection channels has a different role: Transport integrity/source authentication affect evidence reliability. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

steps.title: 來源盤點：對照試驗與證據
steps.titleEn: Source inventory: controlled experiment and evidence
steps.objective: 針對「來源盤點」完成含競爭原因及不確定度的驗收紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: For source inventory, complete acceptance evidence with competing causes and uncertainty.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意，讀取自製的基準與擾動紀錄，不接觸未授權目標。對照「事件來源應有責任人、格式與健康指標。」，執行下列紙上或本地合成資料試驗：固定事件，只改時區及時間偏差。 分開記錄預測、觀察與不確定度，再提出至少兩個可能原因；利用「收集通道」的獨立證據排除一個原因。若結果只來自模型，標記為模擬，不能當作真實設備量測。最後說明目前應接受、保留或拒絕哪一項要求，並保存可重算資料。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit diagram and inspect your authored baseline/perturbed records without accessing unauthorized targets. Evaluate the principle: Sources need owners, formats and health indicators. Conduct this paper or local synthetic-data experiment: Fix events and vary timezones/clock offsets. Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from collection channels to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.
steps.observation: 固定事件，只改時區及時間偏差。 比較「來源盤點」與「收集通道」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix events and vary timezones/clock offsets. Compare whether evidence for source inventory and collection channels supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 把所有日誌集中便能自動判斷事故。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Centralizing every log automatically identifies incidents. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「來源盤點」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for source inventory. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

steps.title: 欄位正規化：對照試驗與證據
steps.titleEn: Field normalization: controlled experiment and evidence
steps.objective: 針對「欄位正規化」完成含競爭原因及不確定度的驗收紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: For field normalization, complete acceptance evidence with competing causes and uncertainty.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意，讀取自製的基準與擾動紀錄，不接觸未授權目標。對照「一致欄位需保留原始值與轉換規則。」，執行下列紙上或本地合成資料試驗：固定事件，只改時區及時間偏差。 分開記錄預測、觀察與不確定度，再提出至少兩個可能原因；利用「事件時間」的獨立證據排除一個原因。若結果只來自模型，標記為模擬，不能當作真實設備量測。最後說明目前應接受、保留或拒絕哪一項要求，並保存可重算資料。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit diagram and inspect your authored baseline/perturbed records without accessing unauthorized targets. Evaluate the principle: Normalized fields retain originals and transformation rules. Conduct this paper or local synthetic-data experiment: Fix events and vary timezones/clock offsets. Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from event time to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.
steps.observation: 固定事件，只改時區及時間偏差。 比較「欄位正規化」與「事件時間」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix events and vary timezones/clock offsets. Compare whether evidence for field normalization and event time supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 把所有日誌集中便能自動判斷事故。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Centralizing every log automatically identifies incidents. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「欄位正規化」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for field normalization. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

steps.title: 事件時間：架構與原理
steps.titleEn: Event time: architecture and principle
steps.objective: 針對「事件時間」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For event time, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「事件時間」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：事件發生時間與收集時間是不同欄位，應分別記錄，數值可能恰好相同。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定事件，只改時區及時間偏差。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「時區與偏差」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around event time, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Event occurrence time and collection time are distinct fields and must be recorded separately. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix events and vary timezones/clock offsets. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat timezone and skew as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 固定事件，只改時區及時間偏差。 比較「事件時間」與「時區與偏差」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix events and vary timezones/clock offsets. Compare whether evidence for event time and timezone and skew supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 相同顯示名稱一定代表同一主體。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Matching display names always identify the same subject. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「事件時間」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for event time. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.
